title: Grateful Dead Live at Student Center on 1969-03-28

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a smoking ’69 show highlighted by a monster Dark Star, The Eleven and an epic That's It for the Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording is a superb‑sounding soundboard tape that delivers crystal‑clear fidelity for a classic spring‑1969 set.  Musically the night shines with a blazing Dark Star, a tight, soaring Eleven, one of the most powerful Death Don't Have No Mercy performances and an unforgettable Cryptical Reprise in That's It for the Other One, all delivered with high energy despite a few minor hiccups.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 5‑star praising both the audio fidelity and the musical performance; only one low rating appears, so overall rating is very high with strong consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, superb sounding tape with great fidelity; a few reviewers note a slight volume tweak needed on Pigpen's harmonica in Schoolgirl but no major issues.

standout_songs: That's It for the Other One (Cryptical Reprise)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical 1969 two‑set flow with a strong, improvisational second set; transitions are fluid and the show builds to a climactic Dark Star and TIFTOO suite.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his incendiary guitar work—new licks, buzzing solos in Dark Star, and overall “in the zone” performance; one note of occasional equipment trouble/fumble.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for a powerful, clear bass line on The Eleven (“great Phil‑bass comin’ through”).
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned stepping up when Garcia falters and providing solid rhythm/jam support during the latter part of The Eleven.
